quote: You waste years waiting for permission to begin. You craft excuses to hide your true fears. You let doubt dictate every single move you make. You think perfection will finally arrive tomorrow morning. But the only moment waiting for you is now. Stop hiding behind shadows of your own making. Just step into the light and finally live.
